title: Net Toolbox
summary: Network tools: diagnosis, ping, traceroute, DNS, speed test, LAN and Wi-Fi.
description: A step-by-step diagnosis of a broken connection in plain words, plus ping, traceroute, DNS lookup, port and HTTP checks, a speed test, public IP, whois, Wake-on-LAN, a Bluetooth radar, a scan of the devices on your network, Wi-Fi networks and channels, a Wi-Fi walk test and the interfaces. No root needed; results can be saved as text. Wi-Fi tools use NetworkManager, the radar needs BlueZ. Works upright in PDA mode.
depends: libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, curl, ca-certificates, network-manager
